title: 保存结果待核实
intent: 可能已写入，先核实同一次保存，不直接重复另存。
brief: Stage8 same save form. Title "这次保存尚未核实". Amber informative banner "文件可能已经保存，但系统还没有确认完成。". Separate approval "已批准", delivery "待核实". Requested filename and folder visible read-only summary. Primary "再次核实此次保存"; no primary retry-save or success. Secondary disclosure "另存一份" with note "选择其他名称或文件夹会另存一份。"; disabled open-folder. No automatic duplicate write.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One high-fidelity raster screen for PrintFlow Studio SCRUM-11168 expanded visual prototype. Reference image is an APPROVED design-system and synthetic-artwork reference, not an edit target. Preserve its calm off-white and white surfaces, forest teal #16765D, graphite text, thin dividers, sensible 10px corners, generous efficient spacing, crisp Simplified Chinese CJK sans serif. Same original geometric mark, exact "PrintFlow Studio" titlebar, small "视觉原型 v2", window controls. One complete front-on edge-to-edge Windows desktop UI screenshot, landscape 16:10, no device/browser/outer presentation board. Same fox illustration and foliage as reference, identical sample artwork and transparent checkerboard when background removed. Default task filename 山野狐狸.png and route 处理客户设计, unless brief overrides. Default left eight-stage user rail: 导入与路线 / 确认原图 / 图片增强 / 去除背景 / 裁切画布 / 印刷设置 / 生成与审核 / 保存结果. Only stages before CURRENT are completed; future steps muted and nonexecutable. Footer fixed with one recommended primary and qualified secondary actions. Main picture and current decision are focal. No irrelevant future forms, no real customer data, no invented operational facts. Use exact quoted Chinese labels in brief; concise text only, no illegible filler. Check prompts' constraints carefully, don't add hidden behavior, automatic approval, auto-resume, printing, cloud or account features. All statuses and measurements are fictional scenario states for prototype, not evidence of a live production file. Output ONLY this one complete practical screen.
SCENARIO: 
IMPORTANT: Reference controls and text must NOT be copied when not in the scenario. Never show a fabricated enhanced result before processing starts. Use spinner only for unknown progress, never ratio-filled progress bars. Do not carry colleague-correction hints onto enhancement/other reviews. No default selection for white-ink choice. title: 同名文件冲突
intent: 不会覆盖原文件，提供显式新名称或更换目录。
brief: Stage8 save form inline conflict. Title "文件名已被使用". Amber copy "目标文件夹已有同名文件，不会覆盖它。". Current "山野狐狸_200mm.tif" with amber outline. Suggested field "山野狐狸_200mm_2.tif". Primary "使用建议名称", secondary "更改文件夹", tertiary "返回修改名称". Note "采用新名称后，仍需确认保存。" No overwrite button, no claim suggestion is already saved.

title: 返回重做确认
intent: 返回重做与只读历史分开，说明下游失效。
brief: Dimmed current size page under centered modal. Title "返回裁切并重新处理？". Bound job "山野狐狸.png". Copy "后续生成结果将失效，已有审核记录会保留。". Three impact rows "当前印刷设置：需重新确认", "后续 TIFF：需重新生成", "已有审核记录：保留为历史". Buttons "取消" neutral default focus, teal "确认返回". Quiet alternate outside modal "仅查看历史". No false file deletion or erasure of history.

title: 离开与放弃确认
intent: 未提交草稿与放弃整个任务有明确区别。
brief: Dimmed task page with centered modal. Title "放弃这项处理？". Bound filename "山野狐狸.png". Clear copy "本任务将停止继续处理。原图保持不变，已有保存记录仍保留。". Explain "未提交的界面输入不会被确认。". Neutral cancel "继续当前任务" with visible initial focus, outlined warning action "放弃此任务" (not teal approve). No automatic deletion, no discard disguised as back, no approving with Enter by default. This image is full task-abandon confirmation; small note draft-only navigation uses a separate keep/discard prompt in flow gallery.
